title: Stop Hardcoding AI Agents w/ Skill.md - Discover KARL
summary: Discover AI walkthrough of Anthropic's skill.md scaffolding pattern + Databricks' KARL paper (March 6 2026, knowledge agents via reinforcement learning). KARL trains AI search agents via RL on synthetic Q&A trajectories, baking learned search policies into transformer weights rather than encoding them as static skill.md instructions. Argues skill.md systems concatenate human instruction without learning; KARL is 'intelligence learned, not coded.' Carl outperforms GPT-5.2 / Opus 4.5 / Opus 4.6 on cost-benchmark.
claims: skill.md systems are static instruction concatenations; agents follow procedures but do not learn or improve them
KARL (Databricks, March 2026) generates synthetic search Q&A trajectories, filters by pass-rate, then trains RL policy on filtered set — baking knowledge into transformer weights
KARL outperforms GPT-5.2 / Opus 4.5 / Opus 4.6 on cost+latency+benchmark per the paper
Distillation of KARL policy to GLM-4.5-air boosts performance from below 55% to 70% in-distribution; RL out-of-distribution generalizes better than distilled SFT

Architecture progression: skill.md (static instruction) -> KARL/RL (learned policy in weights); single search-agent demo with vector search only — multi-tool/multi-agent extension would be substantial
